extraction.method: PyMuPDF text extraction and regex from appendix A4; numeric cells and headers visually verified against rendered PDF page31
source_tables: Figure 8 / Appendix A4: purpose-built rental units under construction by Montreal CMA zone
Figure 9 / Appendix A4: units under construction by dwelling type, Ottawa CMA source label

usage.allowed: Context available before 2025-12-31 for a 2026 forecast, with explicit source periods and tenure
not_supported: No point-in-time historical vintages for cutoffs 2022,2023,2024: do not train or backtest these old values as historically available
Montreal stock is purpose-built rental; Ottawa stock includes all intended markets: no like-for-like rental comparison
Ottawa figure labels CMA but does not explicitly say Ontario part: do not merge with Ottawa Ontario series without geography evidence
Montreal historical month unspecified: keep source annual labels and mid-2025 wording, do not invent exact June dates
Under construction is a stock and not completions; there is no delivery calendar or lease-up rate
No validated improvement to central forecast or MAE

recommended_display.note: Four source values; exact dates of historic stock observations are not specified in figure. Preserve year labels.

schema.geography: Source geography label; Ottawa Ontario not separately established
schema.reference_period: Source label, YYYY for Montreal or YYYY/Q1 for Ottawa
schema.reference_period_precision: Explicit source limitation; no invented exact observation date
schema.dimension: Montreal zone or Ottawa dwelling type; do not compare across this distinction
